## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

MainActivity — new in `:app-wear` (package `com.mgilli.app_wear`) and
`app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/MainActivity.kt`
(existing, template content).

## Trigger

The OS launcher intent (`android.intent.action.MAIN` /
`android.intent.category.LAUNCHER`) — nothing observes it on
`:app-wear` (no `<activity>` at all in its manifest); observed on
`:app-phone`, but the activity it opens renders the Android Studio
template instead of the application.

## Today

`app-wear/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` declares only the
`<application>` tag and its `wearable.standalone` meta-data — no
`<activity>` element, so the module has no launcher entry at all; no
`MainActivity` (or any activity) source file exists anywhere under
`app-wear/src/main/java`. Neither module declares an `Application`
subclass anywhere in the project (`Grep "class.*Application"` across
the whole repo finds none), and no dependency-injection framework is
wired: `gradle/libs.versions.toml` carries no Hilt version, library or
plugin entry, and neither `app-phone/build.gradle.kts` nor
`app-wear/build.gradle.kts` applies one.

`app-phone/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` does declare `.MainActivity`
as `LAUNCHER`, and
`app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/MainActivity.kt`
exists, but its `onCreate` sets content to
`Greeting(name = "Android")` — the Android Studio template composable
defined in the same file — wrapped only in `HyroxTrackerTheme`. It
never reads `PhoneNavigator`/`PhoneDestination` (both already exist in
`app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/navigation/`) to
render the current screen, and no root composable that switches on
`PhoneNavigator.current` exists anywhere in `:app-phone` (`Grep
"NavHost|PhoneApp|@Composable fun.*App"` finds nothing beyond the
navigator/destination classes themselves).

On the watch side, `WatchRaceNavigator`/`WatchDestination` exist
(`app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/`) but nothing
constructs `WatchRaceNavigator` or reads its `current` to render a
screen — no root composable dispatches on `WatchDestination` anywhere
in `:app-wear`.

`app-phone/build.gradle.kts` carries `androidx.activity.compose`
already (used by the current `MainActivity`); `app-wear/build.gradle.kts`
does not declare it at all, so `:app-wear` has no `ComponentActivity`
or `setContent` available to build a `MainActivity` with.

## Expected

Each module carries a real `Application` subclass, annotated for
dependency injection, and a `MainActivity` (`ComponentActivity`) whose
`onCreate` calls `setContent` with a root composable that reads its
navigator's current destination (`PhoneNavigator.current` on the
phone, a constructed `WatchRaceNavigator`'s `current` on the watch)
and renders the matching screen — `RaceListScreen`, `RaceDetailScreen`,
etc. on the phone; `HomeScreen`, `PreparationScreen`, etc. on the
watch. Both are declared in their module's manifest, the activity as
`LAUNCHER`.

Two things this needs, and neither exists yet, so building the
`Application` classes as "for dependency injection" cannot proceed
without them first:

- **Hilt is entirely unwired.** No version, library or plugin entry in
  `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, no `com.google.dagger.hilt.android`
  plugin applied in either `build.gradle.kts`, no `@HiltAndroidApp` /
  `@AndroidEntryPoint` anywhere in the project. The version catalog and
  both modules' Gradle files need the Hilt plugin and dependencies
  added before an `Application` class can use it.
- **`:app-wear`'s `build.gradle.kts` has no `androidx.activity.compose`
  dependency** (`app-phone`'s does), so `:app-wear` cannot build a
  `ComponentActivity`-based `MainActivity` without it being added.

Also missing, and required to give either `MainActivity` something to
render: a root composable per module dispatching on its navigator's
current destination — none exists in `:app-phone` (only
`PhoneNavigator`/`PhoneDestination`, no dispatcher) or in `:app-wear`
(only `WatchRaceNavigator`/`WatchDestination`, no dispatcher, and
nothing constructs `WatchRaceNavigator` today).
